auditMetadata.title: SINC Platform — Comprehensive Performance, Loading Speed & Real-Time Audit

summary.primaryBottleneck: Severe N+1 query multiplication on Feed rendering: 26 posts trigger 312 interaction REST queries (104 likes, 104 saves, 52 comments, 52 shares) and 26 distinct Supabase Realtime channels simultaneously, causing full feed stabilization to take 7.1s to 12.3s.
summary.secondaryBottleneck: attachPostMedia() queries a non-existent table ('public.post_media') on every feed load and post lookup, adding a 344ms blocking error penalty to every post request.
summary.postOpeningBottleneck: Opening an individual post takes 2,612ms because PostView discards existing client state, performs a redundant getPostById() lookup, queries the missing post_media table, and executes 6 interaction queries while rendering a full-page blocking spinner.
summary.bundleBottleneck: Monolithic JavaScript bundle (1.07 MB) and CSS bundle (143 KB) with zero React.lazy route splitting or vendor chunk optimization.

findings.affectedFeature: Home Feed & Post Cards Interaction Fetching
findings.observedSymptom: Home feed requires 361 to 495 network requests and 7.1s to 12.3s to stabilize, freezing the UI with hundreds of parallel Supabase REST calls.
findings.evidence: perf_audit_runner measured 312 interaction requests (104 likes, 104 saves, 52 comments, 52 shares) for 26 posts, taking 2,409ms cumulative wall-clock time.
findings.rootCause: PostCardInteractions.jsx executes getPostInteractionSummary() on mount for each card, issuing 6 REST queries per post. Additionally, each card subscribes to a dedicated Supabase Realtime channel (post_interactions_channel_${postId}), causing double-execution in React 18 strict mode and connection exhaustion.
findings.expectedBenefit: Reduces feed network requests from ~490 to ~15 (97% reduction). Feed stabilization drops from ~10s to < 1.2s.
findings.recommendedFix: Consolidate interaction stats directly into the posts query via database triggers/columns (likes_count, comments_count already declared in schema) or a single batch RPC (get_feed_interactions_batch). Replace 26 per-post channels with a single global interactions channel with client-side routing.
findings.risk: Requires synchronization between optimistic updates and database trigger state.
findings.verificationPlan: Verify that feed loading 26 posts triggers exactly 1 interaction batch request and 1 realtime channel.

findings.observedSymptom: Every post loading operation (Feed, PostView, Profile, Saved Posts) incurs an unnecessary 310ms to 344ms delay and logs schema cache 404 errors.
findings.evidence: backend_query_benchmarks.json measured attachPostMedia() duration at 344ms with error: 'Could not find the table public.post_media in the schema cache'.
findings.rootCause: postService.js attachPostMedia() unconditionally queries the non-existent 'post_media' table on every feed load. The application already persists media as JSON in posts.image_url / posts.video_url.
findings.expectedBenefit: Eliminates 344ms of blocking latency and 404 error logs on every feed and post request.
findings.recommendedFix: Check if post_media exists or bypass the remote table query, using the existing parsed image_url JSON payload directly inside formatPostRow().
findings.risk: None; formatPostRow() already has complete fallback logic for parsed JSON and single URLs.
findings.verificationPlan: Confirm zero 404 errors in console and instantaneous media formatting.

findings.observedSymptom: Opening an individual post detail view takes 2.61 seconds and displays a full-screen blank 'Loading post...' message.
findings.evidence: Measured Post Opening Latency: 2,612ms (Post lookup: 719ms + failing media lookup: 310ms + 6 interaction queries: 1,583ms).
findings.rootCause: PostView.jsx discards the post object that the user just clicked in Feed, Search, or SavedPosts, triggering an un-cached getPostById() call and rendering a blank loading screen.
findings.expectedBenefit: Near-instant (< 100ms) perceived post opening using optimistic in-memory post caching with background revalidation (stale-while-revalidate).
findings.recommendedFix: Pass initialPost object through handleNavigateToPostView(postId, { initialPost, returnContext }). PostView displays initialPost immediately while revalidating engagement in the background.
findings.risk: Stale post content if modified immediately before opening; mitigated by background revalidation.
findings.verificationPlan: Verify transition from feed to post view happens in < 150ms without loading skeleton flicker.

findings.observedSymptom: Initial page load must download and parse a 1.07 MB monolithic JavaScript bundle and 143 KB CSS bundle.
findings.evidence: dist/assets/index-BBHVRi71.js is 1,070,216 bytes; dist/assets/index-BmAplZFG.css is 143,145 bytes.
findings.rootCause: App.jsx statically imports all 27 pages and heavy modals eagerly. Vite config has no manualChunks configuration for vendor libraries (@supabase/supabase-js, lucide-react).
findings.expectedBenefit: Reduces initial bundle by 60% (from ~1.07 MB to ~400 KB). Faster parsing and execution on mobile.
findings.recommendedFix: Implement React.lazy() and Suspense for non-feed routes (Settings, ProfileDetails, ItemUpdates, Achievements, Certifications) and configure Vite manualChunks for vendor splitting.
findings.risk: Requires Suspense fallback skeletons for lazy-loaded route transitions.
findings.verificationPlan: Run vite build and verify main entry bundle size drops below 450 KB.

findings.observedSymptom: All available posts and search results are loaded at once without pagination.
findings.evidence: postService.js getPosts() queries public.posts with no .limit() or .range(). Currently 26 rows take 3,079ms; with 500 rows this will time out.
findings.rootCause: Lack of cursor-based or range-based pagination in getPosts(), searchProfiles(), and getConversations().
findings.expectedBenefit: Limits initial query size to top 15-20 posts, keeping query response under 300ms regardless of database size.
findings.recommendedFix: Add .range(offset, offset + limit - 1) to getPosts() and implement infinite scroll sentinel in Feed.jsx.
findings.risk: Requires handling load-more pagination state in feed components.
findings.verificationPlan: Verify that getPosts() fetches exactly 15 rows on initial load.

findings.observedSymptom: Typing rapidly into the Search input bar triggers database queries on every character.
findings.evidence: Search.jsx useEffect fires searchProfiles() directly whenever searchQuery changes with 0ms delay.
findings.rootCause: Absence of a debounced input hook (e.g. 250ms - 300ms debounce).
findings.expectedBenefit: Reduces search API requests during typing by 75-85%, preventing out-of-order race conditions.
findings.risk: Minor 250ms perceived delay before results update after user stops typing.
findings.verificationPlan: Type 5 characters in under 1 second and verify exactly 1 query is dispatched.

findings.affectedFeature: Who To Follow Widget Query Serialization
findings.observedSymptom: Right sidebar recommendations exhibit a waterfall delay on Home feed load.
findings.evidence: WhoToFollowWidget.jsx executes a sequential for...of loop calling getFollowStatus() individually for 4 candidates.
findings.expectedBenefit: Reduces candidate follow-status resolution from ~600ms to < 120ms.
findings.recommendedFix: Batch query follow statuses using .in('following_user_id', candidateIds) or Promise.all.
findings.verificationPlan: Verify all candidate follow statuses resolve in a single network roundtrip.

findings.affectedFeature: Post Media Image Rendering & Layout Shifts
findings.observedSymptom: Feed post images cause Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) as images finish loading.
findings.evidence: PostMedia.jsx renderItemImage renders tags with no loading='lazy', decoding='async', or explicit dimensions/aspect ratios.
findings.rootCause: Missing standard modern image optimization attributes.
findings.expectedBenefit: Eliminates feed layout jumps, defers off-screen image decoding, and saves mobile bandwidth.
findings.recommendedFix: Add loading='lazy', decoding='async', and aspectRatio: '16/9' or '1/1' container styling to post images.
findings.verificationPlan: Verify that off-screen images are not requested until scrolled near viewport.

findings.observedSymptom: Redundant WebSocket channels listening to the same underlying tables; risk of duplicate processing.
findings.evidence: Both postService.js (public_posts_realtime) and socialService.js (global_posts_channel) subscribe to post events on startup.
findings.rootCause: Legacy socialService channel left active alongside new postService channel.
findings.expectedBenefit: Halves post-related Realtime WebSocket messages and eliminates redundant listeners.
findings.recommendedFix: Decommission legacy globalPostsChannel in socialService and use unified postService channel.
findings.risk: Ensure legacy components importing socialService.js receive post events through postService.
findings.verificationPlan: Verify exactly 1 Realtime channel exists for posts.

implementationOrder: Phase 1: Consolidate post interaction queries into a single batch query or column triggers (Fixes PERF-001 - 97% request reduction)
Phase 2: Eliminate nonexistent post_media table lookups (Fixes PERF-002 - removes 344ms error penalty)
Phase 3: Implement optimistic post passing & stale-while-revalidate in PostView (Fixes PERF-003 - instant post open)
Phase 4: Implement pagination (.range(0, 19)) in getPosts() (Fixes PERF-005 - scales to large datasets)
Phase 5: Route-level code splitting with React.lazy and Vite manualChunks (Fixes PERF-004 - 60% smaller bundle)
Phase 6: Search debounce and WhoToFollow batch query (Fixes PERF-006 & PERF-007)
Phase 7: Image lazy loading, async decoding, and aspect-ratio reservation (Fixes PERF-008)
